_comment: B3Chain testnet wallet configuration blob. Not a Sparrow-native import format (Sparrow has no first-class support for custom networks at this time); this is a documented bundle of the settings a user needs to plug into Sparrow / Specter / Electrum or any compatible wallet to talk to the b3chain testnet. The OPERATOR-SIDE electrum server endpoint is a KNOWN LIMITATION at launch -- we are still standing up a public electrumx instance; until then, point a wallet at a self-run b3chaind testnet node via the JSON-RPC interface (port 18534).

network.name: B3Chain testnet
network.value_disclaimer: Test B3C has NO monetary value. Do not pay anyone in tB3C and do not accept tB3C as payment.

bip44._comment: BIP44 testnet coin_type (1). Mainnet b3chain will register its own coin_type via SLIP-0044 once mainnet ships.

genesis._comment: SHA-256d block-identity hash of the testnet genesis block. PoW hash uses B3PoW-Scratch (see SPEC.md); block-identity hash is still SHA-256d for Bitcoin compatibility.

electrum_server._comment: PLACEHOLDER -- electrum server is not yet deployed for testnet. Wallet integration via Sparrow / Electrum / Specter will work once this endpoint is live; until then, use a wallet that supports a direct b3chaind RPC backend (port 18534 above), or use the reference CLI shipped with b3chaind.

uri_scheme.name: b3chain
uri_scheme._comment: URI scheme matching BIP21 for payment requests. A registered wallet will handle URIs of the form 'b3chain:tb3...?amount=0.01&label=Demo'. Browser-side click-to-pay support requires the user's wallet to be registered as a protocol handler.

sparrow._comment: Sparrow does not yet support custom networks. Workaround: run b3chaind with -chain=test and use the reference CLI for wallet operations. We will revisit this once Sparrow exposes a custom-network plugin API.
manual_steps: Use 'b3chain-cli -chain=test getnewaddress "" bech32' to create receiving addresses

specter._comment: Specter Desktop supports custom Bitcoin-compatible nodes via JSON-RPC. Point it at b3chaind on port 18534 with the rpcuser/rpcpassword from b3chain.conf. Network metadata above must be added manually to Specter's chain-config.

electrum._comment: Electrum desktop client expects an Electrum-server protocol endpoint. Once electrum.b3chain.org is live, point Electrum at it via Tools -> Network -> Server.

btcpay_server._comment: BTCPay Server can be configured to support custom altcoins; this is documented in the BTCPay altcoin guide. Not in launch scope.
